exact_text: README.md identifies docs/state-transition-manifests.md as the normative legal-edge manifest incorporated by PLAN.md and states that this repository is a plan, not a working controller or deployed factory.
review/round-11-resolution.md states that it does not claim independent closure, implementation, full reachable-product proof, semantic evidence validation, or production safety.

Manifest §13.1 RO00-B/RO00-M/RO00-I are exact absent-to-OPEN transactions synchronized with B37/M28/IRB06; each atomically changes the parent Work or rollback tuple and creates the obligation, link, MAINTENANCE child, deterministic event, and creation receipt without CleanupItem or C11.
The creation rows require deterministic generation, absent-or-same/version CAS, byte-identical replay, and conflict or out-of-order rejection.

RO01/RO02 remain the cleanup-resurface C11 creation path; RO01-R/RO02-R create absent/post-close revocation generations directly as REVOKED; RO11-RO13 fence and quiesce existing OPEN/IN_PROGRESS/VERIFYING generations; RO14 is the sole reauthorization path.
RO09 is purpose-specific: cleanup-resurface may remove only exact proved-remediated keys, while rollback-safety closes the remediation child and retains exposure/resource blocks.
BUILD orders RO09 -> B74 -> B34 -> B38, and MAINTENANCE orders RO09 -> M62 -> M25 -> M29; only B38/M29 remove exact rollback-safety blocks while sealing ROLLED_BACK.
B39/M30 require no persisted cancellation, whereas B71/M59 require the authenticated persisted cancellation disposition; exact-version CAS and replay make the branches exclusive.
RO00-I creates exact exposure/resource blocks for the improvement rollback-safety obligation, and RO09 expressly retains every rollback-safety block.
IRB09, IRB03, and IRB07-N/R/Q provide the improvement restoration, verification, and ROLLED_BACK sequence, but none removes or transfers ownership of the exact RO00-I blocks.
The manifest names only B38/M29 as rollback-safety block-removal transactions, although IRB06 is in the same closed rollback-safety purpose partition.
IRB07-N/R/Q partition settlement by NONE/REQUESTED/QUIESCING; with NONE, WIDENING_ABORT uses IR13C-X and other origins use IRB08, while pending cancellation uses IX03 alone.
IRB06 cannot settle falsely; only RO09, IRB09, IRB03, and IRB07 can reach ROLLED_BACK before cleanup. The missing RO00-I block-release mutation is reported below.

findings.title: Improvement rollback remediation has no legal transaction that releases its RO00-I safety blocks
findings.requirement: Every rollback-safety obligation must retain its exact exposure/resource-reuse blocks through genuine restoration and independent verification, then release those exact blocks atomically with the corresponding verified ROLLED_BACK settlement before cleanup or cancellation can close.
evidence: RO00-I atomically creates and blocks the exact exposure/resource keys when IRB06 enters REMEDIATION_WAIT.
RO09 says rollback-safety retains every exposure/resource block and its result names only the BUILD B74/B34/B38 or MAINTENANCE M62/M25/M29 continuations.
The §13.1 closure prose says only B38/M29 atomically remove rollback-safety blocks; PLAN §§13 and 14.0 likewise enumerate B38/M29 despite including IRB06 in the rollback-safety creation partition.
The improvement continuation IRB09 -> IRB03 -> IRB07-N/R/Q reaches ROLLED_BACK, then IRB08/IR13C-X/IX03 may schedule cleanup, but none of those rows removes or adopts the RO00-I block set.
The round-11 witness inventory tests block removal only for B38/M29 and supplies no improvement block-release witness.
findings.impact: A literal implementation either leaves the improvement candidate's exposure/resource keys blocked indefinitely after verified rollback, causing a durable resource leak and undefined cleanup/terminal release semantics, or invents an unlisted unblock mutation. Releasing at RO09 would instead violate the required restoration-and-verification ordering.
findings.required_correction: Add an exact improvement rollback-safety block-release mutation, preferably to each mutually exclusive IRB07-N/R/Q settlement or to a named synchronized row immediately after it. It must require the current RO09 closure receipt, genuine restoration, fresh independent verification, exact RO00-I key-set digest and generation, atomically seal/adopt ROLLED_BACK and remove only those keys, preserve IRB08/IR13C-X/IX03 sole cleanup ownership, and define version CAS, byte-identical replay, conflict rejection, and cancellation race witnesses. Align PLAN §13/§14.0, RO09/§13.1 prose, and the generated witness inventory.
